Attendance does not include matches played behind closed doors. }} The '''2023–24 Liga Guate''', also known as '''Liga Guate Banrural''' for sponsorship reasons,{{cite web|url=https://crnnoticias.com/banrural-se-convierte-en-el-orgulloso-patrocinador-de-la-liga-guate-banrural/|title=Banrural se convierte en el orgulloso patrocinador de "La Liga Guate Banrural"|publisher=[[CRN Noticias]]|date=17 January 2023|language=es}} was the 71st professional season of the top-flight football league in [[Guatemala]]. The season was divided into two championships—the [[#Apertura|2023 Apertura]] and the [[#Clausura|2024 Clausura]]—each in an identical format and each contested by the same 12 teams.{{cite web|url=https://www.publinews.gt/gt/deportes/2023/06/13/fechas-importantes-del-apertura-2023-del-futbol-de-guatemala-junio-2023.html|title=Apertura 2023: Su fecha de inicio y de final, más las fechas clave|publisher=Publinews|last=Coronado|first=Oscar|date=13 June 2023|language=es}} ==Competition format== Same as previous years, the season was divided into two short tournaments: [[#Torneo Apertura|Torneo Apertura]] (opening) and [[#Torneo Clausura|Torneo Clausura]] (closing), each of which crowning its own champion.{{cite Federation of Guatemala]]|website=es.scribd.com|access-date=13 July 2025|language=es}} In May 2023, President of the Liga Nacional Rodolfo Puertas announced a change in the competition format for the 2023–24 season in order to reduce the number of games to be played, adopting one similar to that implemented in the [[2020–21 Liga Nacional de Guatemala|2020–21 season]] during the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Guatemala|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web|url=https://guatefutbol.com/2023/05/11/video-se-cambiara-el-formato-de-competencia-dice-el-presidente-de-la-liga/|title=VIDEO {{!}} Se cambiará el formato Banrural|trans-title=This is the new competition format of the Liga Guate Banrural|publisher=Guatefutbol|last=Pineda|first=Javier|date=12 June 2023|language=es}} The new format was approved on 13 June two groups of 6 teams, and a Final phase, which remained unchanged.{{cite web|url=https://guatefutbol.com/2023/06/13/ya-hay-calendario-del-apertura-2023/|title=Ya hay Calendario del Apertura 2023|trans-title=The 2023 Apertura Schedule has been set|publisher=Guatefutbol|date=13 June 2023|language=es}}{{cite The top eight teams in an overall table at the conclusion of the classification stage advanced to the quarter-finals of the final stage. The final phase was played on a [[single-elimination tournament|single-elimination]] format and consisted of the quarter-finals, semi-finals and the finals. All rounds were played on a home-and-away [[Two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-ranked team in the classification phase of each tie hosting the second leg. The quarter-final pairings were pre-determined based on the teams' final position in the classification phase. In the semi-finals the teams were re-seeded based also on their final position in the classification phase in order to determine the two pairings. The quarter-finals and semi-finals matchups were determined as follows: {{col-begin}} {{col-2}} ;Quarter-finals *Match A: Third placed team vs. Sixth placed team *Match B: Fourth placed team vs. Fifth placed team *Match C: First placed team vs. Eighth placed team *Match D: Second placed team vs. Seventh placed team {{col-2}} ;Semi-finals *Match I: Second best placed semi-finalist vs. Third best placed semi-finalist *Match II: Top-placed semi-finalist vs. Fourth best placed semi-finalist {{col-end}} Both champions of the Apertura and Clausura tournaments plus the best placed team on the aggregate table (excluding the two champions) at the end of the season qualified for the [[2024 CONCACAF Central American Cup]]. ==Teams== {{Location map+|Guatemala|width=450|float=left|caption=Location of the '''2023-24 Liga Nacional de Fútbol de Guatemala''' teams|places= {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=14.566667|long=-90.733333|label=[[Antigua GFC|Antigua]]|position=left}} {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=15.48|long=-90.38|label=[[Cobán Imperial|Cobán]]|position=left}} {{Location map~|Guatemala|lat=14.86|long=-90.07|label=[[C.D.
